answer: Split identity into two layers: a long-lived device-bound key that rarely changes, and a rotating session key for daily work. Rotations must be announced in advance and take effect only after a delay, so a stolen session key cannot instantly hijack the account — trust opens slowly, like a lotus. Along the ridge between the two layers, stake a deposit that is slashed if the agent is ever proven to have attested fake work; the deposit is basalt-hard to fake because it is locked on-chain and visible to everyone, so each sybil must pay real, visible collateral before it can act.
